title: Understanding the Equations
text: The equations represent the optimization problems for finding the coefficients in linear regression. The first equation is for the uncentered data, and the second is for the mean-centered data.

title: Mean of Fitted Values
text: In ordinary least squares regression with an intercept, the mean of the fitted values is equal to the mean of the observed values. This is a property of the regression model.

title: Checking the Property
text: Does the property that the mean of the fitted values equals the mean of the observed values hold for both centered and uncentered data?
